_why: DECLARED DEPENDENCIES. This child may import its own files plus these, and NOTHING else. gitEr/hitch_test.sh enforces it in a sterile room where the host tier does not exist. Adding a line here is a DECISION, not a formality: anything starting with $lib, $tinyStore or $mobRoutes, or climbing into the host tier, is a NO.
_channel_why: THE CHANNEL. One door to the host. The child names the channel, never the host tier. A host wires its real implementation in; the wrapper wires a fixture. Anything the channel does not provide comes back null and the child renders nothing rather than crashing. Every $-import outside this prefix is a SECOND DOOR and hitch_test.sh reports it. CHANGED IN RAPPER PHASE 1: this used to name $parent/siblings/mapShared/ — a folder SHARED by every child. mapShared is gone; its modules went DOWN into the children that actually used them, so the channel is now a path INSIDE this child and travels with it when the child is lifted.
_companion_why: THE COMPANION. Every `@ground-truth/getcache-onlinemap/...` line below is a DECLARED cross-child edge: the wrapper's create script reads this list (companionsOf) and copies getCache_OnlineMap in beside this child at `npm create` time. It is the ONLY source of that copy — an import this list does not name ships alone and dies on an unresolved specifier in the sterile tree (MEASURED 28 Aug 2026: eight files imported OnlineMap, none were declared, `npm create` laid down no companion). getCache_OnlineMap is the shared map home on purpose (one map engine for both Get Cache maps and the where-child); do not copy these modules into this child or into the wrapper.
_app_why: `$app/*` and `svelte/*` are the framework's own — every tier is a SvelteKit app, so they resolve everywhere.
_shared_tree_why: THE SHARED TREE. `$rig/…` (the mounting tier's layout and dev chrome), `$gc/…` (Get Cache theme and art) and `$rt/…` (brand assets) are three aliases every mounting tier defines, all pointing at ONE copy of the tree that lives in the tier that owns it — nothing is copied or synced, and this child never says where. Dev chrome renders only under vite dev; the assets are what a page shows. Declared here so hitch_test.sh can tell a reviewed seam from a second door. A child cloned alone defines none of the three and fails LOUDLY at build, which is the point.
